selection: eligible neighborhood median of worst-path net liquidation-mark USDT; then own worst-path net liquidation-mark USDT; then lower close-MTM drawdown; then stable id
secondary_peak: eligible highest own worst-path net liquidation-mark USDT; frozen diagnostic finalist, not a recheck reselection
recheck_arms: baseline + development-selected robust candidate + development-selected peak (deduplicated)
historical_exposure: All January-April data were observed in baseline research. Later segment is a chronological recheck, not fresh or blind validation.
